defects.title: App crashes when saving a contact with an empty name
defects.description: Tapping Save on the Create Contact screen with the name field blank crashes the app instead of showing a validation error.

defects.title: Saving a contact with only a phone number bypasses name validation
defects.description: A contact with no name but a phone number is saved silently; the name-required rule is not enforced.

defects.title: Duplicate contact detection misses case-insensitive name matches
defects.description: Adding 'john doe' when 'John Doe' exists does not trigger the duplicate merge prompt.

defects.title: Search does not update in real time while typing
defects.description: Results only refresh after the search field loses focus, violating the real-time search requirement.
defects.resolution: Fixed in 1.0.3 — debounced onChange listener added.

defects.title: Cloud sync silently fails on flaky networks with no retry
defects.description: When connectivity drops mid-sync the operation aborts without an error or automatic retry, risking data loss.

defects.title: Export to CSV drops the contact photo reference
defects.description: CSV export omits the photo file reference field even when the contact has a photo.
